short_description: Starkes Allround- und Coding-Modell mit Vision. Gut für Agenten, Tools und multimodale Aufgaben; läuft auf Dedicated-GPUs ab ca. 15 GB INT4.
pitch: Starkes Coding mit Vision — passt ab Dedicated L.
quantization_note: Benchmarkwerte stammen typischerweise aus Standard-Präzision (z. B. BF16/FP16). INT8/INT4 spart VRAM und kann die Qualität leicht senken — im Datensatz gibt es einen Score pro Modell, nicht pro Quantisierung.

score_precision.note: Ein Score pro Modell; nicht getrennt nach FP16/INT8/INT4.

pricing.note: OpenRouter-Referenzpreis. Für mittwald Shared/Dedicated eigene Preise verwenden.

changelog.note: Scores für Toolathlon, JobBench, NL2Repo, SWE-ML aktualisiert

scores_detail.label: Index
scores_detail.name: AA Intelligence Index
scores_detail.description: Artificial Analysis composite index combining multiple evaluations (including τ²-Bench Telecom, Terminal-Bench Hard, GPQA Diamond, and HLE) to synthesize overall model capability.

scores_detail.label: Coding
scores_detail.name: AA Coding Index
scores_detail.description: Artificial Analysis composite index for coding performance combining multiple evaluations (including Terminal-Bench Hard, and SciCodeBench) to synthesize overall model capability.

scores_detail.label: SWE-V
scores_detail.name: SWE-bench Verified
scores_detail.description: Human-validated subset of SWE-bench for fixing real GitHub issues; solutions are judged by running unit tests.

scores_detail.label: SWE-Pro
scores_detail.name: SWE-bench Pro
scores_detail.description: Successor to SWE-bench Verified for realistic software engineering tasks; spans Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Go, and is designed to be more contamination-resistant and industry-relevant.

scores_detail.label: SWE-A RF
scores_detail.name: SWE Atlas: Refactoring
scores_detail.description: Refactoring track of Scale AI's SWE Atlas suite: restructure production code to improve readability and maintainability while preserving behavior; 70 tasks graded by programmatic test validation plus rubric assessment. Metric is Task Resolve Rate (% of tasks passing all rubric items).

scores_detail.label: SWE-A TW
scores_detail.name: SWE Atlas: Test Writing
scores_detail.description: Test Writing track of Scale AI's SWE Atlas suite: write meaningful tests that exercise real functionality and raise coverage; 90 tasks graded by manifest check, mutation testing and rubric assessment. Metric is Task Resolve Rate (% of tasks passing all rubric items).

scores_detail.label: SWE-A QnA
scores_detail.name: SWE Atlas: Codebase Q&A
scores_detail.description: Codebase Q&A track of Scale AI's SWE Atlas suite: deep code-comprehension tasks such as tracing execution paths, multi-file reasoning and answering technical questions, with no code changes required; 124 tasks across 11 open-source repos in Go, Python, C and TypeScript. Metric is Task Resolve Rate (% of tasks passing all rubric items).

scores_detail.label: DeepSWE
scores_detail.name: DeepSWE
scores_detail.description: Benchmark measuring frontier coding agents on original, long-horizon and hand-written software engineering tasks on active open-source repositories; Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go and Rust.

scores_detail.label: F-SWE
scores_detail.name: FrontierSWE
scores_detail.description: Benchmarking software engineering skill at the edge of human ability; hand-crafted tasks, scored by Dominance (pairwise win-rate %) and average rank.

scores_detail.label: F-Code
scores_detail.name: FrontierCode
scores_detail.description: Cognition's benchmark of exceptionally hard, hand-crafted software engineering tasks at the frontier of model capability; contamination-resistant and unsaturated (top models score below 30%).

scores_detail.label: SWE-Re
scores_detail.name: SWE-Rebench
scores_detail.description: A continuously updated, decontaminated benchmark for evaluating software-engineering LLMs on real-world coding tasks under a standardized evaluation setup.

scores_detail.label: LCBench
scores_detail.name: LiveCodeBench
scores_detail.description: Contamination-resistant coding benchmark that continuously collects new problems; evaluates code generation, self-repair, code execution, and test output prediction.

scores_detail.label: SciCode
scores_detail.name: SciCode
scores_detail.description: Scientific coding benchmark evaluating code generation and problem solving in scientific domains.

scores_detail.label: Term Hard
scores_detail.name: Terminal-Bench Hard
scores_detail.description: Hard subset of Terminal-Bench tasks; benchmark of real terminal tasks in sandboxed environments with test scripts.

scores_detail.label: Term 2.0
scores_detail.name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
scores_detail.description: Terminal-Bench 2.0 is a collection of tasks and an evaluation harness to help agent makers quantify their agents' terminal mastery.

scores_detail.label: Term 2.1
scores_detail.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
scores_detail.description: Terminal-Bench 2.1 is a collection of tasks and an evaluation harness to help agent makers quantify their agents' terminal mastery.

scores_detail.label: τ² Tel
scores_detail.name: τ²-Bench Telecom
scores_detail.description: Dual-control conversational agent benchmark where both agent and user use tools in a shared environment; includes a compositional task generator; Telecom domain.

scores_detail.label: CoWork
scores_detail.name: CoWorkBench
scores_detail.description: Qwen in-house benchmark for long-horizon professional cowork tasks across computer science, finance, law, medicine, and other productivity domains. Only Qwen-published scores exist; not independently reproduced.

scores_detail.label: ALE P@1
scores_detail.name: Agents' Last Exam
scores_detail.description: Long-horizon professional agent tasks with verifiable outcomes. Metric is Pass@1 (full pass rate), not the partial-credit Score. Independent runs from the Snorkel ALE leaderboard (best harness) where available; otherwise vendor Pass@1.

scores_detail.label: BrowseC
scores_detail.name: BrowseComp
scores_detail.description: Browsing benchmark with 1,266 challenging short-answer questions designed to be hard to find but easy to verify.

scores_detail.label: AIME25
scores_detail.name: AIME 2025
scores_detail.description: American Invitational Mathematics Examination; 15-question, 3-hour exam with integer answers from 0 to 999, using the 2025 exam set.

scores_detail.label: AIME26
scores_detail.name: AIME 2026
scores_detail.description: American Invitational Mathematics Examination; 15-question, 3-hour exam with integer answers from 0 to 999, using the 2026 exam set.

scores_detail.label: GPQA
scores_detail.name: GPQA Diamond
scores_detail.description: Graduate-level Google-proof multiple-choice science questions (biology, physics, chemistry) from GPQA; Diamond split used in evals.

scores_detail.label: HLE
scores_detail.name: Humanity's Last Exam
scores_detail.description: Humanity's Last Exam: multi-modal benchmark with 2,500 expert-level questions across many subjects, designed to resist internet retrieval.

scores_detail.label: MMMUPro
scores_detail.name: MMMU Pro
scores_detail.description: Vision-centric extension of MMMU that rigorously evaluates large multimodal models on challenging, college-level tasks requiring expert, cross‑disciplinary understanding and integrated visual–text reasoning.

scores_detail.label: OSWorld
scores_detail.name: OSWorld-Verified
scores_detail.description: Benchmark measuring GUI agents' ability to complete real computer tasks in a sandboxed Ubuntu environment; Foundation E2E GUI subset with max 100 steps, scored by task success rate.

scores_detail.label: BFCL
scores_detail.name: BFCL v3
scores_detail.description: Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard v3: multi-turn, multi-step function/tool calling evaluation across structured output, reasoning, finance, agents, and hallucination avoidance.

scores_detail.label: Arena
scores_detail.name: Arena Elo
scores_detail.description: LMArena (formerly LMSYS Chatbot Arena) crowdsourced blind A/B evaluation. Overall Elo score from millions of human preference votes across math, coding, creative writing, and open-ended domains.

scores_detail.label: IFBench
scores_detail.name: IFBench
scores_detail.description: Instruction-following benchmark measuring adherence to complex, verifiable constraints in prompts.

scores_detail.label: SWE-ML
scores_detail.name: SWE-bench Multilingual
scores_detail.description: Multilingual software-engineering tasks across languages; typically evaluated with agent harnesses such as mini-SWE-agent. Often vendor-reported.

scores_detail.label: Toolathlon
scores_detail.name: Toolathlon Verified
scores_detail.description: Real-world tool-use evaluation (Toolathlon Verified, Pass@1). Mix of vendor and independent leaderboard scores depending on model.

scores_detail.label: JobBench
scores_detail.name: JobBench
scores_detail.description: Professional job-task benchmark for agentic workflows. Largely vendor-reported (Qwen model cards); not a widely reproduced third-party leaderboard.

scores_detail.label: NL2Repo
scores_detail.name: NL2Repo-Bench
scores_detail.description: Repo-level code generation from natural language: build or extend repositories under an agent harness (often Claude Code). Vendor-reported in Qwen model cards.
